related.title: 閃爍體粒子偵測器
related.transfer: 可遷移「中子波長、速度與能量換算」與「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；閃爍體粒子偵測器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" and "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scintillation particle detectors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦緩速器、中子導管、斬波器飛行時間、三軸譜儀、³He 偵測效率與計數統計的儀器工程；閃爍體粒子偵測器則以光產額、Birks 淬滅、光收集、PMT 與 SiPM 光電轉換、能量解析度、增益漂移與符合計時為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on instrument engineering of moderators, neutron guides, chopper time of flight, triple-axis spectrometers, ³He detection efficiency and counting statistics; Scintillation particle detectors centres on light yield, Birks quenching, light collection, PMT and SiPM photodetection, energy resolution, gain drift and coincidence timing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱中子與冷中子能譜」與「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到閃爍體粒子偵測器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” and “Activator luminescence centre and decay time”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scintillation particle detectors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 中子散射儀
history.text: 1940 年代後期 Shull 在橡樹嶺石墨反應爐以中子繞射解析晶體與磁結構，1950 年代 Brockhouse 在加拿大 Chalk River 發展三軸譜儀量測聲子，兩人因此共同獲得 1994 年諾貝爾物理獎。1967 年法德合作成立勞厄—朗之萬研究所（ILL），其高通量反應爐於 1971 年運轉並率先大規模使用冷源與中子導管；1976 年 Mezei 提出超鏡，大幅提高導管傳輸；橡樹嶺散裂中子源 SNS 於 2006 年產生第一批中子，代表以脈衝散裂源與飛行時間儀器為主的新世代設施。
history.textEn: In the late 1940s Shull used neutron diffraction at the Oak Ridge Graphite Reactor to solve crystal and magnetic structures, and in the 1950s Brockhouse developed the triple-axis spectrometer at Chalk River in Canada to measure phonons, sharing the 1994 Nobel Prize in Physics. France and Germany founded the Institut Laue-Langevin in 1967, whose high-flux reactor started in 1971 and pioneered large-scale use of cold sources and neutron guides; Mezei proposed the supermirror in 1976, greatly raising guide transmission; and the Spallation Neutron Source at Oak Ridge produced its first neutrons in 2006, typifying a generation of pulsed spallation facilities built around time-of-flight instruments.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「中子波長、速度與能量換算」到「背景、計數統計與試車交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" through "Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
